tools.name: checkDomain
tools.description: Reads the public DNS of one domain and reports SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT findings, risks, unknowns and the exact DNS changes to fix them. Read-only; nothing is stored.

tools.name: quoteFixVerify
tools.description: Runs the email-authentication check of one domain and returns a machine-readable, NON-BINDING quote for Fix & Verify: price (EUR 99 net per domain), scope (exact DNS changes), acceptance criteria and the baseline to verify against later. Orders are not open: it creates no order, contract or payment

tools.name: verifyFixVerify
tools.description: Re-runs the check of the domain and compares it with the acceptance criteria and baseline of an earlier quoteFixVerify result: PASS when every criterion is resolved and no new critical or high finding appeared. Read-only; nothing is stored; a pass is not an invoice while orders are closed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quoteFixVerify · Private data: quoteFixVerify · Public sink: quoteFixVerify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quoteFixVerify · Private data: quoteFixVerify · Public sink: quoteFixVerify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
